brief:
Riyadh has rejected every Israeli proposal to send an evacuation aircraft, including a suggestion to dispatch a plane without official markings, the Ma'an news agency reported citing Hebrew Channel 15. The rejections come as Israel seeks to remove citizens from the region.

A source close to the Saudi royal family delivered a firm message: "Israel must understand that normalization cannot be imposed." The statement reflects Riyadh's resistance to pressure for closer ties with Israel.

title: Saudi Arabia rejects all Israeli evacuation plane offers
